milestone: BTCognitive V33.0 — Research Consolidation & Risk-System Reliability
summary: Formal cryptographic quarantine registry documenting quarantined synthetic and unverified datasets, alongside approved authentic baseline datasets.

quarantined_datasets.quarantine_reason: Fabricated synthetic mock feature dataset. Forensic audit in V32.79 Phase 0 confirmed the generation script used np.random.normal(seed=42) to simulate macro, on-chain, and options regime features. Completely excluded from all production and barrier backtest paths.
quarantined_datasets.contamination_scope: Contaminated 4 historical validation reports prior to V32.79. Core OHLCV barrier backtest milestones (V32.74, V32.77, V32.78) used authentic OHLCV directly and are 100% uncontaminated.
quarantined_datasets.action_required: Permanent quarantine. Prohibited from being referenced or read by any production router or future empirical experiment.

quarantined_datasets.quarantine_reason: Discontinuous upper boundary at +0.000100 (Binance default interest rate component) in 2022, 2025, and 2026, whereas 2023 and 2024 unclamp up to +0.000881. Irreconcilable conflict with contemporaneous local file data/raw/funding.parquet (Pearson r = 0.0159).
quarantined_datasets.contamination_scope: Evaluated in V32.79A, V32.80, V32.80A, V32.80B. Proved strategy has insufficient sample (N=64) and non-significant edge (p = 0.106 to 0.269).
quarantined_datasets.action_required: Quarantined under SOURCE_LINEAGE_UNRESOLVED. Funding rate research permanently frozen under INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Offline research cannot make network calls to verify raw exchange archives.

quarantined_datasets.quarantine_reason: Contemporaneous funding rate file covering Jan-May 2026. Exhibits rates up to +0.000821, with 113 settlements exceeding +0.000228, while binance_funding_2022_2026.parquet is clamped at +0.000100 for the exact same timestamps (r = 0.0159). Upstream collection method via CCXT differs from direct REST endpoint.
quarantined_datasets.action_required: Quarantined under SOURCE_LINEAGE_UNRESOLVED. Neither funding dataset is designated authoritative.

approved_authentic_datasets.role: Core frozen historical OHLCV baseline (2020-2025). Certified free of synthetic fabrication, gaps, or lookahead contamination.
Extended historical OHLCV baseline used for out-of-sample temporal robustness verification.

prospective_evidence_status.governance_note: Prospective collector is currently stopped with lockfile intact. Collection will resume only under governed prospective evaluation with live exchange data connectivity.
